subject.title: Remote-Only Overlay Detection Misses Some Proprietary Remote Desktop Sessions

question: Should remote-only mode expand beyond its documented virtual-display and Screen Sharing/VNC contract, and which vendor-specific active-session signals have an acceptable idle false-positive rate?
rationale: macOS provides no general remote-session event, so proprietary-client support requires a product choice about supported vendors and the tradeoff between missed sessions and locally visible overlays.

options.title: Support proven active signals
options.body: Add a vendor only after connected and idle captures demonstrate a stable active-session indicator with negative regression fixtures.

options.title: Accept broader heuristics
options.body: Recognize selected vendor helpers or ports despite a higher chance of showing overlays without an active viewer.

options.title: Keep current scope
options.body: Retain the virtual-display and Screen Sharing/VNC boundary and recommend Always mode for unsupported clients.

recommendation.title: Support proven active signals
recommendation.body: Add a vendor only after connected and idle captures demonstrate a stable active-session indicator with negative regression fixtures.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and documented the current remote-only detection boundary.
